subject: Post-discovery: pick 30-min demo window + nominate ops owner
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novapulse.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: pick 30-min demo window + nominate ops owner

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: you want to explore Redwood Inference for faster model serving with consistent latencies across cloud and on-prem; the two immediate evaluation goals are (1) latency profiling on your 2–4k qps baseline and (2) a short proof-of-concept for your fraud-detection pipeline with private deployment controls.

Next step: a 30-minute product intro + ops Q&A where we run through latency/cost profile examples and confirm infra owner responsibilities. Can you confirm which of these three 30‑minute windows works best for your team (all times PT):

- Wed Mar 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu Mar 11 — 4:00–4:30 PM PT
- Tue Mar 16 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

For the session we recommend your infra lead + one data engineer. If you could nominate an ops owner (or confirm who will join), we’ll include a short run-of-show. I’ve attached a one-pager and a draft mutual action plan to help scope the POC.

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll route to Vivek (solutions eng) to align the demo content.

Thanks — look forward to locking something in.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novapulse.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@novapulse.io>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: pick 30-min demo window + nominate ops owner

Jasmine —

Appreciate the succinct recap. The goals you captured look right. Of the proposed times, Thu Mar 11 4:00–4:30 PM PT works best for our group.

I’m looping in Priya (ops lead) — she’ll be the primary infra contact for the POC and will bring our platform engineer (Tara) if needed. Priya prefers calendar invites in UTC; for clarity that slot is Thu Mar 11 23:00–23:30 UTC.

Can you include a short agenda (5–7 bullets) so Priya can confirm attendees? Also, we need any basic network/connectivity pre-reqs documented (firewall rules, required ports) so our security team can triage ahead of time.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Platform, Novapulse
alex.turner@novapulse.io | +1 (617) 555-0892
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novapulse.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@novapulse.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: pick 30-min demo window + nominate ops owner

Great — locking Thu Mar 11 4:00–4:30 PM PT / 23:00–23:30 UTC.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-demo-novapulse-20260311-1600 (invite sent to Alex/Priya)
Mutual Action Plan (editable): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MAP-Stub

Proposed 30‑minute agenda (we’ll keep it tight):
- 0:00–0:05 — quick intros & success criteria (Alex, Priya, Tara)
- 0:05–0:12 — product tour: serving runtime, routing and caching highlights (Jasmine + Vivek)
- 0:12–0:22 — infra deep-dive: deployment modes, network pre-reqs, security controls (Vivek)
- 0:22–0:28 — Q&A on POC scoping & timelines (all)
- 0:28–0:30 — confirm next steps and owners (we’ll update the MAP)

Pre-reqs summary (short):
- Allow outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai and our telemetry endpoints (finer-grain IPs in the MAP).
- If you plan to test private deployment, we’ll need a temporary VPN tunnel or S3-based model staging access — Vivek will follow up with exact commands.

Vivek — can you prepare a brief slide with the network ports and a one-paragraph runbook to drop into the MAP before Thu?

Priya — thanks for joining. If you prefer a different attendee mix or want to push to the 16:00 PT slot on Wed Mar 10 instead (for timezone reasons) say the word and we’ll update.

Looking forward — calendar invite has the video link and attachments.

Best,
— Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
